page.layout: One page of text in verse, set as seven stanzas of four lines each. Running head at the top centre. Page number at the top left. A catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

p.i: Regníque spretis ordinibus ferox Edicta princeps regia subruit, Cum matre cogens, heu! tenellum Arma sequi miseranda Regem:
O quàm superbo sæuiit impetu! O quanta Gallis damna tulit furens! Quantasque funestus per urbes Francigenas dedit ille motus!
Sic quum quietos diluuies fera Irritat amnes, & pecus, & domos, Stirpésque raptas voluit vna, Murmure cuncta fremunt tremendo.
Sic inquieto nubilus Adria Tollit procellas Africus horridas: Nautásque per vastum vagantes Exagitat violentus æquor.
Sic dira sæuit bellua, quum fames Væsana[?] torquet, denteque feruido Irata prædam quum repertam, Lanigerósve greges trucidat.
Hinc arua passim Gallica sanguine Madent refuso, prædaque tristibus Feris per agros funerata Francigenum iacuere turma.
Non vrbs acerbis vnica cernitur Intacta[?] damnis, oppida turpibus Quassata bellis, ciuibusque Cunctaque suis viduata lugent.

page.notes: Catchword "Non" printed at the lower right, outside the text block. Right margin shows only faint show-through from the reverse side, not transcribed. "Væsana[?]": first word of the third stanza's second line is hard to read; the letters look like V, æ, then s, a, n, a. "Intacta[?]": initial letter of the line is uncertain. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. Accents on "Regníque", "Nautásque" and "Lanigerósve" are as they appear in the scan, though they may be ink marks rather than accents.
